summary: The air map mode: its setter, its colours (green under intercepts, red under air superiority), the circles of range round the player's air bases, the large air base and anti-aircraft pictures, the tooltip, and the week the list of finished battles keeps an entry. Corrects one test of UpdateAirMapIcons.

structs.name: CAreaCircleObject
structs.comment: A circle drawn on the map with `map/Sector.dds` and `gfx/FX/circle.fx`: the air map mode's circles of range. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airmap.md, section 6.
structs.evidence: UpdateAirBaseCircles allocates 0x218 bytes for it; the RTTI export gives the table at VA 0x15B4CD4 and the base C3dVisibleObject at 0.

addresses.name: CCombatHistory::Prune
addresses.comment: **Keeps the list of finished battles to a week.** The first thing CCombatManager::Tick does each hour, with `lea esi, [manager + 0x18]`. Takes off the front of the list every entry whose hour (+0x8) is after now, then every entry whose hour is before now - 168 (0xA8): an entry stays while it ended at most 168 hours ago. Only the front is looked at. Where the history's byte +0x14 is set it marks the entry's +0x30 instead of freeing it. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airmap.md, section 3.
addresses.evidence: Read from the listing 0x42F830-0x42F95D: `sub edi, 0xa8` before the second loop, `cmp [ecx+8], edi; jge` out of it, and the unlink through +0x2C/+0x28 and `free`. The call is at 0x42FB7D after `lea esi, [edi+0x18]`. Wrong if the list were not kept in the order battles end.

addresses.name: MapMode_Air_Set
addresses.comment: **The air map mode's setter** (mode 18). Unless the mode is already 18, the `click` sound; then UpdateAirMapIcons and UpdateAirBaseCircles on the graphics owner's +0x1DC4; the naval icons down (0x46AA70) when leaving mode 19; the idler's +0xD34 and CMap's +0x2A90 to 18; MapMode_ShowButton(15); the settings +0xE7 = 0, the layer mask +0xF0 = 0xFF9A and the map style +0xF4 = 18; the graphics owner's +0x60F8 = 0; HideProvinceObjects98; MapMode_Air_Colour; Map_RefreshColourTextures(0); the graphics owner's +0x60DC = 1. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airmap.md, section 1.
addresses.evidence: Read from the decompiled C of 0x667EE0: the `cmp [ecx+0xd34], 0x12` before the sound, the constants 0xFF9A and 0x12 written to the settings, and the calls in that order.

addresses.name: MapMode_Air_Colour
addresses.comment: **The air map mode's colours.** Both colours of every province from 1 to 0x80808080; then for every unit of the map's country (CMap +0x2A88) whose order's slot 16 is 0x718 (air_intercept) or 0x6FA (air_superiority), every province of the order's list (+0x44) that the order's slot 38 passes (in range) is coloured: an intercept writes 0x8058FF58 to the first colour and to the second where it is still grey, an air superiority 0x80FF5858 to the second and to the first where it is still grey. So green, red, or striped under both. Called only by MapMode_Air_Set - not each day. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airmap.md, section 2.
addresses.evidence: Read from the listing 0x8673B0-0x8674DE: the two `cmp eax, 0x718` / `cmp eax, 0x6fa` on slot 0x40, the call through slot 0x98 with the province, and the four immediates.

addresses.name: UpdateAirBaseCircles
addresses.comment: **The circles of range round the player's air bases.** ClearAirBaseCircles; then for each province of the player's AirBases (CCountry +0xD70) whose air base object (CMapProvince +0x54) has units: the units sorted by their definition's range (InsertUnitByRange), grouped where a unit's range is within 100 of the group's (the floor of 100.5 at 0x160A684), and for each group a CAreaCircleObject of radius range / 1000 x 0.25 at the air base's position less the label point, coloured (share, share, share, a) - share the regiments' strength over CUnit::GetTotalMaxStrength, a 0.3 where an air unit is selected (a selection entry's slot 1 answers 2) and none of the group's units is selected, else 1 - with its byte +0x160 = share above 0.999 where a is 1. Each circle is kept in the vector at +0x4 with its province. Called by MapMode_Air_Set, CInGameIdler::DailyUpdate, MapMode_SwitchIcons and, when the idler's byte +0x1D3C is set in mode 18, CInGameIdler::Update. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airmap.md, section 6.
addresses.evidence: Read from the decompiled C of 0x86AD60 and the constants 100.5, 1000.0, 0.999, 0.25, 0.3 and 1.0 at 0x160A684, 0x160A300, 0x160A2D8, 0x160A258, 0x15C05EC and 0x171DBAC.

addresses.name: ClearAirBaseCircles
addresses.comment: Takes down every circle UpdateAirBaseCircles made: hides and destroys each of the vector at +0x4, takes one off its province's count of them, and empties the vector. Every map mode setter calls it - 27 call sites. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airmap.md, section 1.
addresses.evidence: Read from the decompiled C of 0x86AC00; the 27 callers from findRefs.py --callers.

addresses.name: HideAirMapIcons
addresses.comment: Takes down the five pictures the air map mode puts on every province from 1: at the province object's +0x60, +0x64 and +0x68 (the three battle icons) and +0x7C and +0x84 (the large air base and anti-aircraft). MapMode_SwitchIcons calls it on leaving mode 18. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airmap.md, section 1.
addresses.evidence: Read from the decompiled C of 0x86A560: five hide-and-destroy blocks.

addresses.name: MapMode_SwitchIcons
addresses.comment: The map mode change's part for the air and naval icons: given 18, UpdateAirMapIcons and UpdateAirBaseCircles; otherwise, where the mode was 18, HideAirMapIcons and ClearAirBaseCircles, and given 19 the naval icons (0x46A6F0); leaving 19, the naval icons down (0x46AA70). Then the idler's +0xD34 and CMap's +0x2A90 take the new mode. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airmap.md, section 1.
addresses.evidence: Read from the decompiled C of 0x678A00; EDI is compared before anything sets it.

addresses.name: ShowLargeAirBaseIcon
addresses.signature: void __stdcall ShowLargeAirBaseIcon(void* mapObjects@ECX, void* provinceObject@stack:4, int level@stack:8)
addresses.comment: **The air map mode's large air base picture.** With a level above 0 and none yet (the province object's +0x7C): the billboard `large_air_base` made, hung on the province, shown, placed through slot 33 at the air base's position (CProvinceTemplate +0x258 by the building database's +0x1C index) less the label point, and its frame set by ProvinceGraphics_UpdateAirBasePicture. Every time: its +0xB28 = (level - 1) x 0.2 + 1. With a level below 1 it is taken down. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airmap.md, section 5.
addresses.evidence: Read from the decompiled C of 0x642960 and the doubles 0.2 and 1.0 at 0x160A260 and 0x160A248.

addresses.name: ShowLargeAntiAirIcon
addresses.signature: void __stdcall ShowLargeAntiAirIcon(void* mapObjects@ECX, void* provinceObject@stack:4, int level@stack:8)
addresses.comment: As ShowLargeAirBaseIcon for `large_anti_air`, kept at the province object's +0x84 and placed at the anti-aircraft's position (the building database's +0x24 index); no frame. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airmap.md, section 5.
addresses.evidence: Read from the decompiled C of 0x642B40, the same shape as 0x642960.

addresses.name: MapMode_ShowButton
addresses.comment: Shows which map mode button is down: every one of `mapmode_1` to `mapmode_16` to frame 1, then `mapmode_` and the number given to frame 2. First, where the settings' +0xF0 & +0xEC has 0x1, every 0x24-byte entry of the graphics owner's +0x1EF8 (counted at +0x1EF4) gets -1 and 0x862260 runs. The air mode gives 15. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airmap.md, section 1.
addresses.evidence: Read from the decompiled C of 0x665980: sixteen lookups through the idler's +0x134C and the slot 0x48 call with 1, then `itoa` and the slot 0x48 call with 2.

addresses.name: InsertUnitByRange
addresses.comment: Puts a unit in a list of units kept by range, smallest first: walking back from the end, after the first unit whose definition's range (CUnit +0xC8, +0x148) is not above the new one's; at the front where there is none. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airmap.md, section 6.
addresses.evidence: Read from the decompiled C of 0x8DD3D0: the compare `<=` on +0xC8 -> +0x148 and the walk through the node's +0x4.

addresses.name: AirBaseCircleGroups_PushBack
addresses.no_signature: The group in EAX and the vector in EDI, nothing on the stack and a bare `ret`; a register-only helper of the one routine.
addresses.comment: Appends a 0x14-byte group - range, strength, most strength, a selected byte, a count - to the vector UpdateAirBaseCircles builds its groups in, growing it through 0x46CD20. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airmap.md, section 6.
addresses.evidence: Read from the decompiled C of 0x86CC80: the five copied fields and the 0x14 stride.

addresses.name: CombatEntryConcerns
addresses.signature: bool __cdecl CombatEntryConcerns(CCombatHistoryEntry* entry, int tag, int id)
addresses.comment: **Whether a finished battle concerns a country**, for the air mode's tooltip: yes where the attacker is the country; where the attacker is a country other than REB, yes where IsSameSide, or where the country's diplomacy status with it has co_belligerent (+0x58) and IsEnemyTag says no; yes where the defender is the country, where IsEnemyTag(defender), or where CanOperateIn(defender); else no. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airmap.md, section 7.
addresses.evidence: Read from the listing 0x432190-0x43222A: the three `add esp, 0xc` call sites push entry, tag and id; the calls to 0x4EF940, 0x42F1B0 and 0x4EFA00 in that order.

addresses.name: CAreaCircleObject::Draw
addresses.no_signature: `ret 0x18`: six stack dwords, of which the body reads two (the renderer and the device); the other four were not identified.
addresses.comment: CAreaCircleObject slot 10: sets the effect's WorldMatrix, ViewMatrix and ProjectionMatrix, `vStrength` to the two floats +0x150 and +0x15C, and `SectorTex` to its texture (+0x140), then draws the vertices at +0x164. `gfx/FX/circle.fx` makes of vStrength = (s, a) a colour from red through yellow (s = 0.5) to green (s = 1) and an alpha of the texture x 0.3 x a. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airmap.md, section 6.
addresses.evidence: Read from the listing 0x401A13-0x401A3D (movss of +0x150 and +0x15C into the two floats handed over with the count 2) and from circle.fx in the install.

addresses.name: CAreaCircleObject::SetRadius
addresses.comment: CAreaCircleObject slot 39: where the radius differs from +0x138, keeps it there and writes the four quarters of the square, centre to radius, each with the whole texture: the centre at texture (1, 1). The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airmap.md, section 6.
addresses.evidence: Read from the decompiled C of 0x401720: the vertices at +0x164 to +0x214, 0x14 bytes each, with the radius and its negation and texture coordinates of 0 and 1.

addresses.name: CAreaCircleObject::GetRadius
addresses.comment: CAreaCircleObject slot 40: `fld [ecx + 0x138]; ret`. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airmap.md, section 6.
addresses.evidence: Two instructions.

addresses.name: CAreaCircleObject::~CAreaCircleObject_scalar_deleting
addresses.comment: CAreaCircleObject slot 9: writes its vftable, runs the destructor body (0x4012B0), frees where bit 0 of the flags is set. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airmap.md, section 6.
addresses.evidence: Read from the decompiled C of 0x4016C0, `ret 4`.

addresses.name: HideProvinceObjects98
addresses.comment: Hides, through its slot 14, the picture at +0x98 of every province object that has one. The air mode's setter calls it; which picture that is was not read. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airmap.md, section 1.
addresses.evidence: Read from the decompiled C of 0x863EC0.

addresses.name: Map_RefreshColourTextures
addresses.signature: void __stdcall Map_RefreshColourTextures(void* map@ESI, void* colours@EAX, bool more@stack:4)
addresses.comment: Hands the map its province colours again (0x480DE0); where the map style (settings +0xF4) is 16, 18 or 19, refills the sea's colours (WaterTexture_Update); and where the argument is set runs 0x4813C0, not read. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airmap.md, section 1.
addresses.evidence: Read from the decompiled C of 0x880D90.

addresses.name: UpdateAirMapIcons
addresses.comment: **What the air map mode shows of battles and air bases.** Three counts for every province, one byte each and read back signed, out of the list of finished battles. For each entry of kind 3 (an air battle) or 4, 5, 6 (a bombing), by its province: where the player owns or controls the province or is the entry's defender, or the defender is a real country other than REB that IsSameSide with the player, or with which the player's diplomacy status has co_belligerent (+0x58) and IsEnemyTag says no, a bombing counts as **bombed us** and an air battle as an air battle. Otherwise, where the player is the entry's attacker, or CanOperateIn(attacker), or IsEnemyTag(defender), a bombing counts as **bombed them** and an air battle as an air battle; an entry that is none of these is left out. Then for every province from 1 ShowBombedUsIcon, ShowBombedThemIcon and ShowAirBattleIcon with its three counts. Then for every province from 1 whose template has +0x13D: ShowLargeAirBaseIcon and ShowLargeAntiAirIcon with the built level (+0x20) of its air base (+0x304) and anti-aircraft (+0x308) where the player's intel of it is above 1, else with 1 where there is one at all. Called by MapMode_Air_Set, CInGameIdler::DailyUpdate in mode 18 and MapMode_SwitchIcons. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airmap.md, section 4.
addresses.evidence: Read from the decompiled C of 0x86A1E0: the test at 0x86A36B is `[edx + 0x58]` of `[player + 0xE28][defender id]`, a CDiplomacyStatus; the counts are `char` and pushed with `movsx`.
addresses.revises: Read the fourth test as the defender 'existing'; it is the player's co_belligerent byte with it. Named the two building pictures, the byte counts, and province 0 being skipped.

addresses.name: CInGameIdler::DailyUpdate
addresses.comment: CInGameIdler virtual slot 53: repaints the map in modes 4/18/19, then always runs the autosave check. Takes nothing on the stack (bare `ret` on all three paths) and returns true - every path sets `al, 1` before the epilogue. The mode is the dword at +0xD34; mode 4 calls MapMode_Supply_Colour (0x266EE0); **mode 0x12, the air mode, calls UpdateAirMapIcons (0x46A1E0) and UpdateAirBaseCircles (0x46AD60)** - not the mode's colours, which only its setter makes; mode 0x13, the naval mode, calls 0x46A6F0; all three on the map object's +0x1DC4. Every path ends with `push esi; call 0x261D20`, the autosave check. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airmap.md, section 1.
addresses.evidence: The calls at 0x661CDB and 0x661CE1.
addresses.revises: Named 0x46AD60 and said the air colours are not redone daily.

addresses.name: ProvinceTooltip_Mode18
addresses.comment: Tooltip builder branch for map mode 18, the air mode. With ours = the player controls or owns the province, counts the entries of the list of finished battles at this province: kind 3 where ours or CombatEntryConcerns(entry, the player) as air battles, kinds 4-6 so as bombings. Then `AIR_TOOLTIP_BOMBING` with NUM = the bombings where above 0, and `AIR_TOOLTIP_DOGFIGHT` with NUM = the air battles where above 0, each a line. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airmap.md, section 7.
addresses.evidence: Read from the listing 0x49C3DE-0x49C6A7: the province id compared at +0xC8 of the +8 subobject, the kinds 3 and 4-6, the strings at 0x15BE82C, 0x15BE840 and `NUM`.
addresses.revises: Said only that it shows AIR_TOOLTIP_* lines.

struct_fields.name: marks_only
struct_fields.comment: Where set, CCombatHistory::Prune marks an entry's +0x30 instead of freeing it - which would loop on the same entry. Nothing was found setting it. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airmap.md, section 3.
struct_fields.evidence: The two `cmp byte ptr [esi + 0x14], bl` in 0x42F830.

struct_fields.name: pruned
struct_fields.comment: Set by CCombatHistory::Prune in place of freeing the entry when the history's +0x14 is set; RecordCombat writes 0. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airmap.md, section 3.
struct_fields.evidence: `mov byte ptr [ecx + 0x30], 1` in 0x42F830 and the byte cleared in 0x42F960.

struct_fields.name: anti_air
struct_fields.comment: The province's anti-aircraft building, as CProvince +0x308. UpdateAirMapIcons sizes the large anti-aircraft picture by its built level (+0x20). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airmap.md, section 5.
struct_fields.evidence: UpdateAirMapIcons reads +0x308 beside the air base's +0x304; ShowLargeAntiAirIcon places its picture at the building database's +0x24 position, which is anti_air.

struct_fields.name: selection_changed
struct_fields.comment: Tested and cleared by CInGameIdler::Update each frame; where set in the air mode it redraws the circles of range, which depend on what is selected. Likely set when the selection changes; its writers were not read. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airmap.md, section 1.
struct_fields.evidence: The `if (this->field_0x1d3c != 0)` block of 0x6559D0 calling 0x86AD60 for mode 0x12.

struct_fields.name: radius
struct_fields.comment: The circle's radius, in map units. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airmap.md, section 6.
struct_fields.evidence: Written and compared by SetRadius, answered by GetRadius.

struct_fields.name: share
struct_fields.comment: The strength share of the circle's group, also at +0x154 and +0x158; the first half of vStrength. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airmap.md, section 6.
struct_fields.evidence: Written by UpdateAirBaseCircles; read by Draw at 0x401A13.

struct_fields.name: dim
struct_fields.comment: 1, or 0.3 where an air unit is selected and none of the circle's group; the second half of vStrength, a factor on the alpha. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airmap.md, section 6.
struct_fields.evidence: Written by UpdateAirBaseCircles; read by Draw at 0x401A22.

struct_fields.name: full
struct_fields.comment: The share above 0.999, where the circle is not dimmed. Read by none of the circle's own four routines. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airmap.md, section 6.

slots_noted: The other new functions are called directly and sit in no table.
notes: Nothing here was watched in a running game.
What the shaders make of a province colour's alpha was not read.
